title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: This news article highlights the massive public and institutional impact of Fabio Giglietto’s study 'A Pretty Blunt Approach.' The article covers how his research—which analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts—became the central focus of a national television investigation on Rai3's 'Report' and served as the direct basis for a formal inquiry inside the European Parliament regarding social media algorithms and democratic integrity.
description: An article discussing the political and public fallout of Professor Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithms, including its feature on Rai3's 'Report' and subsequent European Parliament inquiries.

title: Agcom accende i fari su Meta: "L'algoritmo favorisce gli account estremisti"
snippet: An article reporting on the Italian Communications Authority (Agcom) launching a formal inquiry and seeking hearings with the authors of the University of Urbino Carlo Bo study. Coordinated by Fabio Giglietto, the study claims Meta's moderation algorithms penalize moderate political positions and disproportionately benefit extremist groups.
description: An Italian news article reporting on the regulator Agcom launching an inquiry into Meta's algorithms, referencing a University of Urbino study coordinated by Fabio Giglietto.

title: La fermata del Garante - Report

description: An investigative segment on Rai 3's program 'Report' highlighting Fabio Giglietto's research into Meta's recommendation algorithms and their impact on democracy.

snippet: Broad news coverage detailing Fabio Giglietto's breakthrough study 'A Pretty Blunt Approach'. The article explains how Meta's implementation of political content reduction policies backfired, severely suppressing mainstream representatives' visibility while acting as an asymmetric boost to extremist and anti-EU accounts.
description: An Italian news article reporting on a study led by Prof. Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino, analyzing the impact of Facebook's algorithm on the reach of mainstream versus extremist political accounts.
